summary: Feed s080_single is degraded: SIEM 1 Gbps port is severely overloaded by 4.33 Gbps microbursts (433% of capacity) across 2 intervals. All other checks (duplicates, encrypted_share, missing_vlan, one_way, oversize, packet_drops, truncated, tunnel) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding unfiltered traffic bursts peaking at 4.33 Gbps in 1 ms intervals to a single 1 Gbps SIEM port with no load-balancing or filtering, exceeding port capacity by ~333% and breaching the 80% overload threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM NIC buffers overflow and drops packets during bursts, causing missed events, incomplete correlation and detection blind spots; SIEM cannot keep up with peak rate despite not requiring both directions or full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute the 4.33 Gbps burst across multiple 1 Gbps SIEM ingest ports (or upgrade to 10 Gbps) via packet broker load balancing to keep per-port utilization below 80% and prevent burst-driven drops.
